typography.hero_heading: text-6xl sm:text-7xl md:text-8xl font-black tracking-tighter uppercase
typography.price_was: text-sm font-semibold text-gray-500 line-through decoration-fire-red decoration-2
typography.font_family_recommendations: Use a heavy geometric sans or condensed font for headings and numeric pricing (e.g., font-black). Avoid generic regular weights for any clearance elements.

structure: Background: Subtle CSS-based infinite marquee reading 'WHILE STOCKS LAST' (opacity 10%, text-void-black text-stroke-1 text-stroke-white).
Content Wrapper: p-8 md:p-16 flex flex-col md:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-8 z-10 relative.
Left Column: Giant 'BIG CLEARANCE' title with brand-yellow text-shadow. Subtext emphasizing final sale.
Right Column: Prominent 'Download Clearance Leaflet (PDF)' button CTA.

product_card.container: relative bg-white border-2 border-gray-200 hover:border-fire-red transition-all duration-300 p-4 rounded-none group
product_card.pricing_layout: flex items-end justify-start gap-3 mt-4. WAS price aligned top or left, NOW price dominant and large.
product_card.stock_indicator: w-full mt-4 bg-gray-100 rounded-full h-8 relative overflow-hidden border border-gray-300

clearance_badge.description: Big Clearance label with yellow background and bleeding red fire illuminating text effect.
clearance_badge.classes: px-5 py-2 bg-[#e5d918] text-[#FF2A00] font-black rounded-sm animate-badgeglow uppercase transform rotate-2 inline-flex items-center gap-1 shadow-lg text-lg border-2 border-[#FF2A00]

pdf_download_button.classes: inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 px-8 py-5 bg-fire-red text-white font-black text-xl uppercase tracking-wider hover:bg-brand-yellow hover:text-void-black transition-all duration-300 shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(255,42,0,0.5)] hover:shadow-[0_0_25px_rgba(229,217,24,0.6)] cursor-pointer

stock_urgency_bar.text: absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center text-xs font-black text-void-black uppercase tracking-wider mix-blend-color-burn

percentage_off_burst.classes: bg-void-black text-white px-2 py-1 text-xs font-bold uppercase rounded-sm inline-block -rotate-2

motion.instructions_to_main_agent: Inject these custom keyframes into /app/frontend/src/index.css using pure CSS and map them in tailwind.config.js if necessary. Avoid heavy external animation libraries.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure the fire_red text on brand_yellow background meets contrast ratio standards. If strictly inaccessible, utilize text-shadow or a darker crimson outline for legibility.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for the marquee and fire-glow pulse.

GENERAL_UI_UX_DESIGN_GUIDELINES: No generic centered layouts for the hero; utilize tension, asymmetry, and scale to guide the eye.
Implement glass-morphism cautiously; since this is e-commerce, readability is priority. Solid backgrounds for clearance elements work better.
Add 'data-testid' to ALL interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='clearance-pdf-download', data-testid='clearance-product-card', data-testid='clearance-badge').
Never use generic standard weight for prices. 'WAS/NOW' must feel punchy and large.
Do not use emojis in UI. Use lucide-react icons.
Do NOT use inline styles for the keyframes. Append them to index.css and integrate with Tailwind properly.
Buttons should feel heavy and substantial (e.g., sharp corners, strong hover shadows) to align with 'The Performance Pro' aesthetic.
